- Female Bengon are often larger than males.
- Bengon are social creatures who take care of one another. If a mother needs to separate from her child for any reason, the group will care for the child.
- Bengon use herding tactics in order to hunt fish.
- When in danger, Bengon will protect their soft bellies by curling up and using its hardened tail fins as a shield.
- When the water becomes too cold, Bengon migrates to hot springs.

entries.name: Bolatra
entries.content: The Bolatra is a quadrupedal creature that combines the features of a Hydra and mushroom, specifically the inky cap. Its default colors include different shades of purple, white, and black, with the main body being white. It possesses three heads, with the middle head being the largest; each head lacks eyes, and its cranium takes the shape of a sharp, wavy-edged mushroom's cap that drips tar-like, inky substances. The creature has serrated teeth, with the middle head having a split upper jaw. Its long, thin necks are subtly studded with four fungi-like structures colored purple underneath, resembling gills. Additional fungi structures can be seen on its chest, thighs, and the base of the tail, some of which have purple coloring on top. Its necks also bear wavy, fur-like structures, similar to the head caps, on the lower necks, back, and wrists/ankles of its dominant limbs, with the largest structure located at the base of the neck. The Bolatra has six limbs: two long front limbs with three toes/fingers, a shorter pair of theropod-like arms with four fingers, and thin back limbs with anisodactyl feet. Each limb ends in long, sickle-shaped claws. Additionally, the creature's long front limbs have a mushroom's cap on the elbows, and has black inky forearms. The Bolatra also has a black underside on the lower torso and a long, black inky tail with four mushroom's caps at the tail's end. They are parasitic and colonial carnivores.

entries.name: Boreal Warden
entries.content: The Boreal Warden is a titanic, quadrupedal creature with a similar but frail build compared to that of the Lmakosauruodon. It does not seem to possess flesh in some areas with bone-like structures for its legs. It appears to have a beak for a mouth, its head resembling an owl. It sports several large head feathers resembling that of Native American war bonnets. It also has a cloak over its back, draping onto its tail. Bioluminescent bulb-like shards resembling Christmas lights are found floating all around its body, mainly at the base of the tail and the sides of the creature, while feathers are found on its face and its back, arranged by size. Lastly, large chunks of ice (sometimes floating) are located on its neck, belly, and back. Its color palette consists of grays, cyans, dark blues, and blue-grays. Floating above its beak is the Boreal Warden's signature feathery Warden mask. Males have three feathers floating next to each leg. Females have three feathers floating above their tails. The floating feathers present with each gender have glowing orbs present on them, the same glowing "bulbs" that are found on the body of the Warden. They are herbivores.

entries.name: Borenhir
entries.content:
The Borenhir is an owl-like creature similar to the Athulyth. It has a faint clockwork/robot/ice crystal look, with metallic-looking plates and tipped line patterns. Its head features a large crest, and another crest appears as the base of its tail. Splotches, speckles, and various other patterns can be found on its wings and back, including three snowflake-shaped spikes protruding from its wings. Its color pallet consists of grey, white, and blue. They are carnivores.
- The Borenhir often spend time with the Athulyth, being related to them.
- They both help each other.
- Borenhir are more alive and expressive than their counterpart and need to eat and drink like other creatures.

entries.name: Boskurro
entries.content:
The Boskurro is a quadrupedal creature that has a forward-leaning body, shifting its weight onto two incredibly thick, widely spread armored forearms that are used to spread its weight around like snowshoes and hold up a long neck adorned with large and pointed, petal-shaped spiked plates of armor leading up to a small face with beady eyes and a unique crest shaping the chin and extending upwards atop its snout with two tusk-like teeth on either side of its head. Its back legs are significantly smaller, and further down, it has a row on top and below the tail comprised of dull yet large spikes. Around the tail, front and back legs, and head are green-colored floating orbs. It consists of light and dark blue-greens and light and dark browns. Its jaw consists of outwards-facing teeth, as well as a long, thin, flat dark-bluish green tongue and tipped beak to support its omnivorous diet. Males have spikes on their elbows as well as orbs floating above their shoulders. Females have an orb floating above their heads. They are omnivores.
- Boskurro lay eggs.
- Boskurro are subspecies of Equenix, adapted to live in forests rather than bodies of water.

entries.name: Brequewk
entries.content:
The Brequewk is a hummingbird-like creature with ridges of leaf-like feathers running down its back and chest. It has a long, thin tail and thin triangular wings reminiscent of a hummingbird. On the dorsal (upper) part of each wing are two additional leaf-like feathers which jut from the wing. Brequewk has a unique upper beak, a good portion of which is striped and curves upwards. Males have flashy fleshy growth around their eyes, which resembles a rooster's wattle. Females have an additional ridge of leaf-like feathers near the base of their tails. They are herbivores.
- The Brequewk are similar to bug swarms and would absolutely demolish flora wherever they choose to nest.
- The Brequewk, despite being similar to bug swarms, actually form smaller units up to around fifty individuals.
- Brequewk flies in a formation that is meant to intimidate predators (its wingtips are reflective and it forms an image similar to a wave-like pattern throughout the flock) paired with the fact that Brequewk can also be loud (hummingbird wingbeats). This makes it so that if the colors don't scare the predator, then maybe the sound will deter a predator if all else fails.
- Brequewk will scatter into the nearest foliage if possible due to their leaf-like camouflage being very effective.

entries.name: Buff Eulopii
entries.content: The Buff Eulopii is based on the Eulopii. The main differences between the two are that the Buff Eulopii is larger, bipedal, more muscular, and has a broad torso and abs. Males have short eyelashes and more flowers around their underarm. Females have long eyelashes and some additional flowers on their backs and shoulders. Like basic eulpoiis, they are herbivores.

entries.name: Buukon
entries.content: The Buukon is a short and stout quadrupedal creature covered in armor. Its front limbs are widely built and covered in scales that also cover its head and neck. It has folded paws with extremely long, sharp claws and small thicker plates protecting the front of its fingers. On the back of its front legs as well as its tail and brow, are longer scales, almost resembling feathers. Males have tufts of fur by their nose. Buukon are passive-aggressive herbivorous tanks that utilize their thick and heavy armor to threaten and injure opponents, as well as shelter itself.

entries.name: Bäruw
entries.content: The Bäruw is a hunky quadrupedal creature, with its forelegs being considerably thicker than its hindlegs. The creature is covered with something akin to a pelt or a bearskin rug, with two faux legs as part of the "pelt" that it wears. One pair of these legs can be found before its forelegs, with second pair lying on top of its hindlegs. Both pairs of its legs end in clawed, five-toed paws, while its faux legs only have four claws and no distinct toes. The Bäruw's tail is flat and shaped similarly to that of a beaver's, and the top of its tail has a ring of curved thorn-like spines along the edges. The creature is incredibly fluffy, with noticeable masses of fur on the start of its back as well as the backs of its legs. It has an elongated, sharp-toothed jaw that resembles a beartrap. Males have a tuft of fur under their jaws. Bäruws are solitary creatures that are masters of camouflage. They wait patiently in lush forests for the perfect time to strike, one bite from its powerful jaws is enough to tear off limbs or completely crush its prey. They are even adept swimmers, using their flat tails to propel themselves through the water, making them truly a nearly inescapable threat.

entries.name: Caldonterrus
entries.content: Caldonterrus is a massive creature that walks on 2 sturdy legs with multiple toes each. The head looks jagged and has orange highlights representing magma, while it has a nasal horn coloured black and grey. The neck is covered in sharp rock structures and has a blue glow running down to the middle part of the tail, with the color representing hardened magma or obsidian. The arms have extra orange highlights and split off into 2 separate lower sections of forearms at the elbow joint, with each hand having 4 claws. On Caldonterrus' back lie heightened rocks that bend forwards that decreases down the tail, and carry an eerie glow inside of it consisting of various oranges and yellows. The creature walks with an upright stance, but in a semi-hunched position when sprinting. Males have large and spiky horns with coursing lava on the insides of the tips. Females have a large nasal horn. Caldonterrus are cataclysmic entities of tectonic energy, and want nothing more than to watch the world burn. They carry with them a large pool of lava that they must constantly fill to fuel their destructive powers.

entries.name: Cantapodi
entries.content:
The Cantapodi displays a colorful skin pattern, with the default colors being tan, purple, black, and green. The Cantapodi has two toes on each foot, resembling a chameleon, and is intricately decorated with numerous spikes and flower buds. It has the natural stance of a kangaroo and other creatures with long tails, using it when walking and leaning on it when idle. It also has a long, spiky tail with a flower at the tip. It appears shorter than it is due to the spiral curvature of its spine-covered tail. Males have two horns on the frontal region of their head and lack the flowers that females have. Females lack horns but have flower buds along their bodies. They are photocarnivores, meaning they eat meat and don't need water to survive. Cantapodi are opportunistic, desert dwelling scavengers. They are nomadic and are bult to run long distances in search of food. The cacti on their bodies stores water, to keep the cantapodi hydrated during during its endless search. The cantapodi's large, hooked foreclaws assist it in combat, usually against other creatures trying to steal their meal.
- Similar to snakes, Cantapodi will bury their eggs to keep them safe from predators and to shield them from the scorching sun. When they hatch, they band together and form a temporary pack as a defense before eventually branching off as they mature.
- While the Cantapodi are blind, they can map out their surroundings using a “sixth sense” not unlike that of a modern platypus. Their sense of smell and adept hearing also helps make up for the lack of sight.

entries.name: Cavengauu
entries.content:
The Cavengauu is a bulky quadruped that appears to resemble a partially peeled banana with some Hydra and Cerberus inspirations, with its heads and necks resembling the flesh and the rest of its body the skin of a banana. The Cavengauu is one of the few creatures to sport many heads. The middle head appears to be the largest of the three heads present. The Cavengauu sports rather muscular forelegs, ending with five curved, blunt-clawed toes. However, its hind legs are significantly less bulky and have three-clawed toes in a shape that appears similar to a zygodactyl bird (with only 3 toes). It has lines of small, blunt spikes on the side of its elbows and on the side of its thighs. It is huge in size and sports excellent patterning across its body. Its tail is rather thick, possessing blunt-tip spikes all around the end. Cavengauu's color scheme is a mix of pale and dark yellows, browns, and some hints of black. Cavengauu are giant hydras that reside in the warmer, lusher areas of Sonaria. The middle head is the larger, dominant head, and often stops it’s two smaller heads from quarreling with each other.
- Cavengauu reside in the warmer, lusher areas of Sonaria, often in large sociable packs (typically with 4-8 individuals) called bunches. The middle head is the larger, dominant head and often stops its two other heads from quarreling.
- In a bunch, Cavengauu, with the most heads (up to five), tend to be the most dominant.
- Cavengauu rot with age. Elders of the species are often kicked out/left behind by their bunch as this process begins.
- Rather than lay eggs, Cavengauu plant seeds and protect the sprouting trees.
- Cavengauu use their thick tails to topple trees and destroy rocks to make room for their large nesting areas.
- Cavengauu nesting areas are often decorated, usually with harvested foliage and pretty rocks.
- It is entirely possible for Cavengauu to reproduce asexually.
- Babies grow in bunches connected at the tail but break off once they're able to walk by themselves.
- Male Cavengauu often babysit while females search for food.
- Cavengauu are monogamous and have partners for life.
- Cavengauu heads are very picky; in order to become partners, each head on one Cavengauu has to like all three heads on another Cavengauu.
- Often, they gift prized items to their partners.
- Same-gender Cavengauu couples are common.
- If a head is undesirable, the other heads will rip it off.
- Cavengauu will knock each other's tails together as a means of affection. When sleeping, they almost always sleep with one another.
- Growth stage determines their colors:
- Green Cavengauu are just babies/juveniles. They don't taste particularly very good but otherwise are vulnerable to most predators. Juvenile Cavengauu are especially playful and can sometimes be seen batting smaller creatures (Such as Minawii) around in the water.
- Yellow Cavengauu are mature adults and have developed a thick, tough peel to protect their bodies.
- Brown/Black Cavengauu are elders and need to be cared for by their kind. Their flesh is soft and mushy, leaving predators struggling to open and close their mouths afterward.
- Cavengauu almost entirely feed on poisonous/toxic creatures. As a result, it makes their peels very gross and unappetizing to chew on. Their diet also makes their meat to become slightly radioactive; large amounts can sometimes make creatures feel sick.
- Their peel is not skin and doesn't hurt when removed. However, doing so forever leaves them vulnerable to predators.
- Cavengauu raid nests and eat the eggs of smaller creatures often as well.
- Cavengauu can't swim, however they can easily float.

entries.name: Celeritas
entries.content: The Celeritas resembles a mix between a snake and a Quetzalcoatlus or other large pterosaur. It sports an aerodynamic V-shaped body with multiple horns and back spikes in the same shape. It has two pairs of wings, a large forward pair, and a second smaller pair attached to its hind legs. Males have a clump of three small spikes on the front of their heads. Females have a large thick spike on each of their shoulders. Celeritas is a large aerodynamic wyvern creature with features meant for cutting through the air, and soaring long distances. Vulnerable on land and advantageous on wing, picking a fight with one of these large creatures wouldn't be so smart.

entries.name: Cenicara
entries.content:
The Cenicara is a quadrupedal, primarily brown creature with orange and black accents that resembles several members of the cervid family. Its four legs each bear hooves, with the front legs having three toes and the hind legs having five. Eight large, curving horns that appear to have candles with wisps of flame at their tips sprout from the top of its head. Off-white wax drips from its back and on its antlers. It has tufts of fur in the same color on its tail and shoulders. Its eyes are yellow with rectangular pupils, similar to those of goats and sheep. Large tufts of fur run from the nape of its neck to its chest. Its neck also has orange, black, and white-molten-wax-like striped markings. A scythe sprouts from above the foot of both of its front legs. On its flanks, it has two small, red ribbons in the shape of a bow. It has a graceful, slender body and skinny legs. Males have a large, curved horn sprouting from each of their cheeks. Females have extra tufts of fur at the base of their necks.
- When playing, some Cenicara will blow out the candles on other Cenicara's bodies in a game of tag.
- When extremely agitated, the fire on their candles flares; they have been known to cause forest fires.
- When running from something, their tails flip up, showing the white of their tails (similarly to the white-tailed deer).
- Cenicara use their candle lights as a way to find each other.
- Cenicara use their two metal-like scythes on their front legs for attacking.

entries.name: Chamei
entries.content: The Chamei looks like a cross between an amphibian and a fish. It has three pairs of short, blunt legs and a smooth, rotund body. Its most prominent feature is a pair of wide pectoral fins that allow it to swim quickly in the water, similar to a manta ray, or eagle ray. The Chamei also has small facial tendrils that have bioluminescent tips that may function as sensory organs. Females have two extra fins where the tail begins. The Chamei is a large whale-like creature with spots scattered across its back and fins. They are extremely friendly and are known to dwell in large groups called "aggregations". They enjoy the warm shallow waters of Sonaria, and feed amongst the tall seagrass.

entries.name: Chisudo
entries.content: The Chisudo appears to be a small-medium wyvern, sporting a weirdly-shaped, large beak with black gums and sharp teeth, as well as wings with separate membranes. Each wing has a single large, clawed thumb with a striped pattern. It sports vibrant green-yellow colors, along with black markings on its body, wings, and tail. Across its body are segments of armor, commonly with spikes protruding from the segments. The largest of these spikes are the four on the back of its neck, sharper and more curved than the rest, similar in appearance to the membranes of its wings. Males have a thin, upright feathers sprouting from their foreheads. They are carnivores. Chisudo circle the skies in an endless hunt to fuel themselves on anything they can scrounge up. Be it the wood from the forest or the meat of they prey that succumbed to their strength. From the day Chisudos are replicated, they must search for blood, seeking the iron hidden within to keep themselves healthy.

entries.name: Chrysos
entries.content: The Chrysos is a slender, spiked quadrupedal reptilian creature. A pair of inward-curving horns are located at the back of its head. It has two sets of fangs on each side of its mouth, spikes running along its neck, back, and tail, as well as fearsome claws. There are more spikes on each of its limbs. Males have two additional 'horns' on either side of their lower body near their hind legs. Females have tufts of fur behind their lower jaw. They are carnivores. Chrysos are aggressive carnivores. They're extremely territorial towards other creatures, especially when they have offspring. Female Chrysos care for their young until they're old enough to fend for themselves.

entries.name: Cimidstik
entries.content: Cimidstik resembles a wingless stick insect using cinnamon-like camouflage and some arthropods with serrated parts. As such, it presents six long extremities stemming from their 4-segmented thoracic area, each with a serrated femur and ending with two tarsal claws; a pair of long slender geniculate antennae with a serrated inflexible flagellum, a pair of compound eyes on their heads, and several cinnamon-bark-like tubercles decorating its head as snout and ear-crest facsimiles, three pairs decorating the thorax's sides, and slight bark bump protrusions covering its neck and abdomen/tail dorsal area; that surely serve as camouflage aid. Males present a tuft of fur/cinnamon bark sprouting from their front ventral thorax area. They are herbivores. Cimidstik tend to stay near branches to camouflage themselves from threats. Their sweet and woody smell attracts Cimmabu, who provide warmth and protection to these fragile creatures.

entries.name: Cimmabu
entries.content:
The Cimmabu is a quadrupedal creature that has an overall cinnamon roll design theme. It has a short, squarish head with a rounded nose, as well as big bright eyes. It has a smooth neck and body, and upon its back is what appears to be a cinnamon roll-shaped shell or saddle. Its tail also seems to curl up into a cinnamon roll shape. Along its neck, shell, and tail, the Cimmabu appears to be covered in a substance similar to icing or glaze. The Cimmabu has 5 toes on each of its feet. They are herbivores. Cimmabu are soft and sweet creatures, both emotionally and physically. They reside in the warmer parts of Sonaria, usually calling the middle of the desert their home. Living in such extreme temperatures doesn't have any effect on Cimmabu due to their half-baked bodies absorbing the heat.
- Cimmabu are very dumb and often find themselves in dangerous situations, seemingly oblivious to it all.
- Despite their stupidity, Cimmabu make great parents and form huge families with up to 200 Cimmabu in a single family.
- Due to any one family's large size, as well as an individual Cimmabu's thick shell and body, they regularly sleep out in the open.
- Cimmabu are deceptively heavy.
- Because Cimmabu look easy to eat, many young predators try to hunt them.
- As Cimmabu age, they slowly become tougher and harder. They also significantly darken in color.

entries.name: Citrulantis
entries.content: The Citrulantis is a colorful quadrupedal creature with a similar build to a giraffe, having a long neck and posture which aligns with its neck. It has many leaves and plants with a citrus-like pattern growing from its neck and lower back — these plants can also be found in slices on its head and chest. Its tail consists of two layers, a top of colorful smaller leaves, and a lower layer of longer green leaves. Colorful tendtrils sprout from below the tail. Males have two small ossicones on their head. They are photovores, which means they only need water and sunlight to survive. Citrulantus are tall thin plant like creatures that are very flighty. They are alarmed by the smallest sound and are quick to jump away. They bounce like deers skipping when running. Their small curly tongue is used like a straw to slurp up water.

entries.name: Clovilowper
entries.content: The Clovilowper is a quadrupedal jackalope-like creature with floppy ears. Its main body's default colors consist of different shades of green with a white underside. On its head are two large four-leaf clovers stacked on top of each other, acting like a hat, with a heart-shaped four-leaf white clover sprouting through the middle. More of these heart-shaped clovers are found across its body. The Clovilowper has two small black eyes with black eyeliner, a black nose, three pairs of whiskers, rabbit-like teeth, and a face that constantly smiles with pushed-up cheeks. The tips of its floppy ears are shaped somewhat like a heart. Long pairs of branch-like structures are seen on its back and base of the tail, most of which end with flowering heads of pinkish florets. Its neck has white fluff at the front and white spots on the sides. Light pink spots are also seen on its back, atop the hind legs, and tail. A cluster of large one-leaf clovers cover its back. The creature has four toes on each leg, with a green three-leaf clover marking on its upper front limbs and two white ones lower down. Its chest also has a big green three-leaf clover marking, surrounded by a larger white one. Additionally, three pink flowers with heart-shaped leaves decorate half of its long tail. A similar pair of flowers can be found at the ends of the structures on its back. The tail tip itself somewhat takes the shape of a three-leaf clover. Males have long antlers, with vine-like tendrils wrapped around them, sprouting from their heads, and a pair of long branch-like structures with flowering ends, similar to those on their back, sprouting from behind the ears. Females have shorter antlers and lack the additional pair of branch-like structures that males have. They are photovores, which means they only need water and sunlight to survive. While these creatures come as a notably rare sight. Their presence alone has been said to sprout miles of clovers and small pink flowers, bringing life to unseen areas of the world. Clovilowper are so extremely rare that just finding enormous beds of overgrowth comes as an unusual occurrence. Finding even a single Clovilowper would bind your fate to good luck for a lifetime.

entries.name: Colval
entries.content: The Colval has an almost parrot-shaped body. It has a long tail with long, narrow feathers at the ends, along with three (3) sets of feathers near the throat and belly. Layers of feathers running down the legs and wrap around the base of the tail. Large feathers hang by the cheeks and chest. This creature’s colors consist of multiple shades of green, grey, and white. Females possess two (2) long feathers hanging from the bottom of their jaw. They are herbivores. Colval are social creatures that live in large flocks. They are passive but moody creatures that will fight back if they feel they need to. It's very rare to see a Colval alone, they form close bonds to few individuals and will stick close to them. They are susceptible to getting injured, but pack a powerful bite with their huge beaks.

entries.name: Coniferon
entries.content: The Coniferon is a quadrupedal, long-necked creature. It has a short tail that, along with its neck, is adorned with greenery similar to that of an evergreen tree. Its stomach and legs seem to replicate wood, with brown colors and swirled patterns. It has a clump of fur or leaves/needles on each foot. Its head is similar to that of a bird's, bearing an ornamental golden crest consisting of two horn-like structures with floating crystals at their tops, along with a golden ribbon found on either side of its head. Two of the same ribbons can be found on its tail. On each of its legs, it has a "frill" similar to the other greenery covering the majority of its body. Males have small orange crests on their legs and shoulders. Females have two multicolored bells on each side of their neck. They are photovores, which means they only need water and sunlight to survive. A gentle giant bearing a star-like crest at the top of its towering neck. Gazing up from below a Coniferon's neck makes it seem as if there is a second North Star in the sky. It will sometimes raise smaller creatures with its ribbonlike appendages for a better view of the starry nights.

entries.name: Corsarlett
entries.content: The Corsarlett is a wyvern-like creature appearing to be based around coral. Its legs are thin and agile, with pamprodactyl scaled bird-like feet and hooked claws, along with a vibrant pink, rounded, coral formation on the ankle. Its frills, reminiscent and positioned akin to wings, rest on the shoulder, where there should be forelegs, it lacks them. Its tail is thin, but begins thickening at the midsection, with armor-like coral protrusions. Its neck is slim and serpentine, akin to a western dragon, having curved white striped patterns running down it. It has a short, flexible frill starting where the pineal eye would be and ending at the middle of the neck. It has a long, slim snout, reminiscent of a Spinosaurus or a gharial in structure, having a tusk-like formation from its chin, as well as two gritty horns, having a crest above its small eyes. In the middle of its upper jaw, and appearing again yet larger on its chest, is a pink, opaque, shiny orb. The ends of its wing-like frills, coral protrusions, tusks and horns are all a gradient of pale pink to a deep, luscious, nearly red shade of pink. The rest of its body is a mix of deep and semi light blues, with the Corsarlett's underside being a dull, yet light shade of blue. Females have frill-like structure on their arms. They are herbivores. Corsarlett are beautiful frilly creatures that thrive among the coral and plants of Sonarias oceans. They are rather docile creatures unless threatened. They often stay within the corals aside from when they annually migrate to different oceans across Sonaria.

entries.name: Corvurax
entries.content: The Corvurax is a large, vulture-like creature with two small arms located on the underside of its upper torso, and two large, somewhat bulky legs. It's mostly black and grey in color, with colorful accents of blue, green, and purple seen throughout it, as well as bright orange on the underside of its tail. The Corvurax has very slim, yet long wings, which bear a repeating pattern of circles. Its feet are reminiscent of the modern-day crow. It has four glowing yellow eyes, two on its lower jaw, and two on its head. Males have an additional large tail feather. They are carnivores. Corvurax is a nomadic flyer whose colorful coat hides a voracious cunning vulture. They often destroy other's nests and take up cozy shelters to breed their own offspring. These speckled crows easily adapt to a wide variety of conditions and live in large bustling groups.

entries.name: Cottol
entries.content: The Cottol is a skeletal sheep-like quadrupedal creature. It has a mane of round wool around its head and chest, with additional wool on its rear and legs and a large cotton ball at the end of its long, thin tail. It has large ram horns and a rather skull-shaped head, with its nose being indented similarly to a sheep's skull, as well as small markings on its mouth, giving it a toothy appearance. Centered on its spine are four vertebrae-like bones along with four rib-like bones down both its sides, and small spikes on its tail give it a bone-like appearance. These creatures also lack a pupil. Males have a small horn on their foreheads. Females have additional fluff on the bottom of their stomachs. They are herbivores. Cottol are sheep-like friendly creatures with a neck and body full of an extremely comfortable fluff. Male cottols have strong large horns for duels, and when threatened by predators they will flee.

entries.name: Crata Peretina
entries.content: The Crata Peretina is a top-heavy creature with larger front limbs and slim hind legs. It has bioluminescent structures that sprout from its back, rear, and tail. Its color palette consists of opposing colors. When in the dark, certain spots on its body will glow, such as the teardrop shape near its eyes. It possesses some mammalian features, like paw pads and a slightly feline face. This creature seems to have some similarities with a sea slug, such as the bioluminescent spikey structures on its back and the blue color variants. These spikes are similar to a sea slug's cerata. Spikes similar to the ones on its back can also be found on either side of its neck and atop its head. They are herbivores. Crata peretina is a large slug like creature, touching or even getting near this creature can leave you intoxicated or paralyzed. Though even with great toxin and the ability to paralyze Crata have rather weak skin, leaving them to take heavy hits.

entries.name: Cryptoth
entries.content: The Cryptoth is a slow-moving bulky herbivore reminiscent of a giant ground sloth. Large spines that resemble large candles sprout from its spine and head. Its head resembles a bare skull, and there are three eyes on its neck. Males have candlestick-like protrusions attached to their front legs. Females have what appears to be tufts of fur on their wrists and ankles. They are herbivores. The Cryptoth is a slow, lumbering beast. Despite its threatening appearance, it is quite passive and gentle, and prefers to eat from bushes rather than you!

entries.name: Cucuerpum
entries.content: Cucuerpum is a long, quadrupedal creature with a light brown body resembling wood, with darker accents running along the base. It has two heads resembling jack o'lanterns with a leaf-like mane and four whisker-like leaf blades (also seen on the underside of both its tails and the topside of its body). Both heads are decorated with a witch's hat, each with a small pumpkin belt decoration. There are another six squash decorating its body, two on its shoulders, another two on its back, and finally one at the end of each of its two tails. Cucuerpum has a large leaf on each of its shoulders, along with two other smaller leaves. The same leaves can also be found above its hind legs, and two smaller pair sets can be found decorating the top of the tail pumpkins. Males present additional leafy spikes protruding from their back and their elbows. They are photocarnivores, meaning they eat meat and don't need water to survive. Cucuerpums are known for their devious and annoying behavior, enjoying bothering other creatures and making themselves a nuisance. They are capable of catapulting the pumpkins at the end of their tails at other creatures to antagonize them. Don't worry, they grow back!

entries.name: Cupuere
entries.content:
The Cupuere is a crêpe version of an amalgamation between a whale, several types of fish, as well as dinocaridids-like swimming flaps. As such, the Cupuere possess bilateral symmetry, a head and a toothless mouth at the front of their bodies and their hydrodynamic mysticeti body supports 3 pairs of primary swimming flaps, which the Cupuere uses to propel itself across the seas though a continuous flipper and vertical motion. Males have caramel antennae extending from above their eyes. They are herbivores. Cupuere are friendly, gentle creatures made of a soft, velvety crepe body drizzled with chocolate. They're always the perfect warmth and are often used as blankets by other creatures during colder weather.
- Cupuere are herd animals, very rarely straying from their group. However, they are friendly enough that they do not mind a new Cupuere joining their herd.
- During summer months, Cupuere herds congregate in an unknown location and change their herd members.
- Cupuere are born soft and velvety, but as they age, they slowly become harder and darken in color, becoming less and less of a target for predators. The oldest known Cupuere, while hard as a rock, was tiny.

entries.name: Cuxena
entries.content: The Cuxena is a slim, bipedal, dragon-like flier that wields a scythe. Its face is somewhat oval-like, and it has 3 eyes. Cuxena has spiraling horns with what resembles gold clasps on them. It is adorned with bone-like decorations and the aforementioned gold clasp. Cuxena has tattered wings, and its tail fin also appears to be tattered. It is one of the only creatures to wield a weapon (specifically a scythe), and is able to do so due to its long and posable fingers. Females have an extra group of bone-like spines located on the mid-tail area. They are carnivores. Often associated with passing and times of sorrow, they appear near the end of a creature's life but bear no ill will. They endlessly roam the land, searching for something they lost long ago.

entries.name: Dabaemura
entries.content: The Dabaemura is a wasp-like creature with 6 legs. Its antennae curve in, making an intimidating appearance as a scythe, and its diamond-colored claws and mandibles pop out against its gold-colored body. The Dabaemura has a massive, jagged stinger on the end of its abdomen, used for stabbing and immobilizing its prey. This creature also has one set of golden wings, that which also represents a wasp's patterned wings. Females have longer face antennae, as well as a longer stinger. They are carnivores. Dabaemura, a perilous pest in Sonaria's deserts, possesses stingers capable of paralyzing victims. They construct vast underground colonies within canyons, operating under a matriachal system with a queen and female workers forage and defend while males protect the colony.

entries.name: Dalghara
entries.content:
The Dalghara is a large, winged creature with looks that resemble that of a manta ray's. Its tail is long and thin, ending with a layered fin. Two other pairs of patterned fins can be found on its body, one seemingly where its neck ends and the other close to where the tail begins. A small, triangular head rests on a plated, bulky neck, making it front heavy. A pair of delicate horns can be found on the back of its head, and little tusk-like horns can be found near its cheeks. Its two pairs of wings are huge and spiked, starting from the middle of the neck and ending at the middle of its tail. One pair of wings have chambered patterns, faintly resembling a Monarch butterfly's, and the other, larger pair has a tipped-line pattern going from shoulder joint to the end, only being stopped by a line going around the wing. Its color palette consists of purples, black, and dusty oranges/yellows. Females present a pair of floating, diamond-shaped details over their head. They are herbivores. Dalghara are massive, graceful celestial rays that travel in large pods across the skies of Sonaria. They are naturally passive, yet aggressive if provoked.
- Dalghara find smaller creatures cute in the same way elephants find humans cute.
- Dalghara are very affectionate with their packmates as well as other passive creatures, especially the Delmothin.
- They are quoted to be similar to "the nice family that feeds the neighborhood on holidays"
- They despise mud and general filth.

entries.name: Danténos
entries.content: Danténos is a bat-winged Balrog-like creature, apparently a being of shadow and flame in aspect. It is a massive, bipedal, demon-like creature with two large horns and a face that resembles a skull. Its legs end in cloven hooves. The tail has 2 growths at the tip, and the top part of the tail is lined with fins that have the tip pointing towards the tail-tip. They are carnivores. Danténos are shameful creatures regarded for their chaotic and destructive history. However, because of this stigma, they are highly misconcieved; while their methods may be questionable and ruthless, they have an unwavering sense of justice that none can infringe upon.

entries.name: Demetyra
entries.content:
The Demetyra is a ruminant-like creature with similarities to bovids, specifically cows with short horns and highland cattle, but with a more streamlined and elongated shape, and some leafery and flowery motifs, especially on their shoulders, ears, mane and exceptionally large and thick tail, where a tulip-like flower bud resides on its tip. More highland cattle similarities are noticeable on their snout and their hair-covered face that hides their eyes as adults. A tag with a heart can be found hanging on their left ear. Males present straighter ears are and have slightly larger, curvier forked horns. Females present more droopy ears and have smaller horns than the males. They are herbivores. These playful creatures are most commonly seeing during spring (and summer), since it’s when they come out of their winter hibernation. Herds of them can be seen trotting through open fields. Their trail always leaves lush vegetation behind, as Demetryas play a key role in pollenating all sorts of ground dwelling plants.
- Demetyras try to be careful around smaller creatures, as to not hurt them.
They use their tulip-like tail to collect pollen from flowers and use it to pollinate other plants.
- Demetyras can commonly be seen near other herbivores, as they have a beneficial relationship with them. The herbivores help protect the Demetyra, and the Demetyra helps plant growth in the area.
- Unlike most herd animals, Demetyras don't run away from most predators, and will work together to fight back and protect their young.
- Their diet consists mainly of nectar, fruit, and grass.
- Sightings of Demetyras indicate the beginning of spring.
- A group of Demetyras is called a bloom.

entries.name: Denjzi
entries.content:
The Denjzi is a large 2-legged creature with a giant woody shell with spikes forming on its back. They have long bodies with 6 lateral fins, 2 pairs close to the base of the legs and the remaining one close to the end of the shell, located where their back legs should be. Their tails present a larger webbed fin used for swimming underwater. They also have two ear fins protruding from the sides of the head and 4 horned spikes on their back neck. On the bottom jaw, they present 8 whisker-like long decorations, first two smaller pairs next to the snout and 4 leafy-end, larger ones short decorations on the base from the jaw. Males have a single crest on their snouts, with a small floating element on the tip. Females have a small crest on their chin. They are carnivores. Denjzi are elusive serpentine creatures inhabiting the vast sea of Sonaria. While they typically dwell deeper below the tides, they occasionally surface to crawl on shore and seek out food.
- Denjzi can travel vast distances without the need to rest.
- Denjzi use their bioluminescence to attract prey in the darker, deeper regions of the sea.
- Denjzi usually travel in groups of 2-3, however seeing a lone Denjzi is not uncommon.
- Denjzi are opportunistic and will eat anything they can find.
- Denjzi can be highly aggressive if provoked.
- Denjzi nest annually and produce 3-6 eggs, though usually, only 25% of a litter will survive to adulthood.
- Denjzi can be very social with their groups, but aggressive toward outsiders, including others of their species that they find unfamiliar.
- Denjzi will often roll around in the sand to rub off parasites or for fun.
- Denjzi can communicate to each other through ‘dancing’ or ‘courting.’
- Denjzi will sleep on the tops of kelp, anchoring themselves to it using their arms and using the kelp leaves as a pillow to lay on.

entries.name: Despisicle
entries.content: The Despisicle is a draconic creature that bear two detached arms at the front. The color consists of mostly blue with a black pattern located to its crown and chest and elbow, whilst having a Ghostly appearance coming out from its mouth, arms and the side of its body. Females have an extra pair of tendrils by the base of their tails. They are carnivores. Despisicle is a frigid soul, quietly floating through icy windstorms searching for an easy meal, this ice wraith creates a sharp decline in temperature when it is on the ground. Creating ominously large snowclouds and blizzards, this spirit is capable of morphing each and every snowflake that begins to fall, into jagged blades of ice.

entries.name: Diemarjla
entries.content: Dieamarjla is built like a bipedal reptile, adorned with dark, overlapping scales around the tops of its head down to the tip of its massive tail, which has six large, fiery orange scales. Moreover, its head appears to be crowned with two horns, which may be connected to its presumed ears. It carries sharp, sickle-like claws and is equipped with dromaeosaur-like talons, even possessing a large sickle toe claw. The color scheme of Dieamarjla is similar to that of a coral snake, symbolizing its toxic nature. Males have a pair of giraffe-like horns on their head, accompanied with cheek armor. Females present spiked scales decorations on the sides of their tail. They are carnivores. The Dieamarjla is an armored bipedal opportunistic carnivore. The thick keratin armor plates ridden across their body protect them from extreme conditions such as intense heat within the desert. They are able to eat and digest any kind of meat -- rotten or not.

entries.name: Diesura
entries.content:
The Diesura is a slim bipedal creature with its appearance similar to that of a kangaroo. It has long ears, with the tips having a colorful combination of red, orange and yellow. The front of its legs are covered in colorful armored plates, as well as having long, sharp claws. It also has colorful spikes protruding from its forehead as well as its back, several deer-like speckles are shown on some parts of its body. Large amounts of clumped fur are seen on its chest, head and on the tip of its long tail. Male Diesuras have extra spikes along their tail. Female Diesuras have horns but lack the extra spikes males have. They are herbivores. Diesuras are pack creatures, they're stronger in numbers but well off on their own most of the time. They use their strong legs to kick/claw/fight to fend off predators.
- Diesuras will allow smaller creatures to ride on their back (examples include a Belluvaraptor riding a Diesura).

entries.name: Diokrine
entries.content: The Diokrine is a theropod with low saturation levels of green that shares characteristics with the dinosaur Dilophosaurus. It has leafy frills and a head crest with a vivid blue underside. They feature short front arms, long, lean legs, and a narrow tail that ends in leaf-like appendages. Their mouth has projecting, long, razor-sharp, blazing blue teeth that curve, giving the impression that they will bleed and deliver a lethal bite. The Diokrine lacks eyes but possesses blue pits on the sides of its snout that resemble the heat-sensing pits on snakes. Males have an additional ridge of leaf-like spines running across the top of their tail and the back of their hind legs. Females have a ridge of three large, leaf-like structures jutting from their back. They are photocarnivores, meaning they eat meat and don't need water to survive. These beasts are always hungry and searching for food. They're agile, fast and intelligent. Most of them hunt in packs in order to overpower their prey, however it is possible to witness solitary Diokrine.

entries.name: Doragonix
entries.content: The Doragonix's appearance resembles Leopard geckos and the depictions of Dilophosaurus seen in the "Jurassic" franchise. Doragonix's tail clearly resembles that of a dragonfruit, and upon losing the tail, the flesh looks like the flesh of a dragonfruit. It has three toes on each foot, each equipped with large claws. It has two crests at the sides of its head, which uses to scare off predators. Doragonix's eyes are similar to a Leopard geckos', with a black, vertical pupil. Its body is splashed with patterns that are identical to the flesh of a dragonfruit, as the white marks resembles to flesh, and the black speckles are the seeds. Males have three whisker-like protrusions on top their heads. They are photocarnivores, meaning they eat meat and don't need water to survive. Doragonix are small and agile photocarnivores. Most of the time they are actively roaming across the oasis, but during midday rest atop large boulders to sunbathe for energy. It's not uncommon to find a Doragonix's tail dropped in the sand from where it was chased.

entries.name: Dowatt
entries.content:
The Dowatt is a quadrupedal, robotic and rodent-like creature with a design themed around electricity and futurism. It has armor plates covering its spine, which runs down the creature's back and ends in a long, segmented tail reminiscent of a power plug. Two pairs of black and yellow wires connect the creature's head with its back armor, and another goes from the lower jaw to the throat. It's neck sports a yellow lightning shape. Dowatt's head is narrow and wedge shaped, and it's covered with a dark glasslike helmet that has two yellow markings on the sides. It has long, pointy black tipped ears, and rodent teeth. The creature's body, neck, ears and upper half of the legs are covered in fur, featuring light brown and white patterns in the shape of lightnings. Meanwhile, the belly, tail, spine, head and lower half of the legs show the artificial nature of its design, with a color palette that clearly separates these areas from the furred parts, presenting three tones of dark blueish grey and yellow. Male Dowatts sport three antennas cresting their neck. Females have six antennas (three per side) protruding from their back. They are carnivores. Dowatt are small, artificially created beings that originate from a far away planet. Their main mission in the Orb is the surveillance and analysis of the environment. Dowatt are not organic in nature, instead being a mix of synthetic muscles, an intricate computer system and electric circuits working as nerves. Dangerously high levels of voltage flow through their wires, forming a defensive mechanism against predators.
- Groups of Dowatt can be called "kilowatts", "megawatts", and so on, depending on their size.
- Dowatt's internal supercomputer as well as its software can be modified to perform any of the tasks that an average PC can do. This means that you can run any informatic program you wish on it. Due to this, you can, indeed, play Creatures of Sonaria inside of Sonaria.
- Dowatt's origin is in a planet several light years away from the Orb, albeit it went a long process of modifications and artificial evolution before its final version arrived to the Sonarian Orb. Its creators were an advanced civilization of interstellar-traveling creatures, which also created many other inorganic/mechanical lifeforms using their futuristic technology.
- Dowatt aren't sentient; they have no self-awareness as a species, and lack an individual "mind". It's likely that their AI systems were truncated to not achieve any of these on its own. It can solve problems and process large amounts of data like any supercomputer, but it's doubtful whether it can be considered a true life form or not.
- Dowatt don't need to eat or consume organic nutrients at all, as they don't have a natural body. If desperate, they can convert the meat they eat into power, but this isn't very useful for them.
- Dowatt look completely lifeless when they have no power running through their electric system. This is when they're "turned off" to save power and "sleep". They normally are kept in this state inside of underground bases, while they wait to go outside for daily environment surveillance missions.
- The inside of a Dowatt's helmet contains a rotating high resolution camera and an extension of its computer system. This is covered in a glassy material that protects them from harsh light, wind, and any external objects that could damage them.
- Dowatt's electric circuits are akin to nervous and circulatory systems. They distribute power and data across its body, muscles, and computer systems. Electric power is especially concentrated on the external areas of the electric circuit: the exposed spine, the neck wiring, and the antennas. The energy they carry is so high that to a human, even standing near them is dangerous. Touching/biting any of these elements can shock a weak creature to death. Due to this, many creatures and predators think twice before attacking it.
- These creatures, for obvious reasons, are extremely vulnerable to water, and stay away from it at all costs.
- During rainless electric thunderstorms, an unusual number of Dowatt go outside and glide up in groups to catch electricity from the ambience with their antennas. However, if directly struck by a lightning, their circuits overload, often leading to death.

entries.name: Dragonixsauria
entries.content: The Dragonixsauria is a dinosaur-like creature with horns on its back, a large body, and spikes along its tail. The creature has a several frills under its head and a small crest on the top of its nose and small protrusions above its eyes. On its neck, there are a couple of scales. The Dragonixsauria's appearance resembles a Shantungosaurus or another type of Hadrosauridae, a group of herbivorous dinosaurs classified for their characteristic duck-like beaks and crests found on some of their heads. It also has large sails running down the length of its back, ending where its tail starts and continuing near the end of its tail, resembling those of Stegosaurus or another type of stegosaurian dinosaur. Males have additional frills at the base of their neck. They are herbivores. Large Herbivore ancestors of both Moemoea and Lmakosauruodon they wander in the plains of Sonaria in large family herds in search of fibrous plants to eat. They are especially good at eating sea grasses and kelp in shallow waters.

entries.name: Dunklaestus
entries.content:
The Dunklaestus is a quadrupedal, amphibious creature that shares many similarities to the prehistoric fish Dunkleosteus, but with two pairs of tetrapod legs. It has armor covering its head, neck, chest, legs, and underbelly. It also has two sails, one that starts on the top of the back, and the other underneath the start of its tail after the two pelvic fins, these two sails can be seen running down to the end of its tail. Additionally, the start of two small sails can be seen on its chest and back. The Dunklaestus appears to be colored with shades of black, brown, and light blue. Males present two decorative undulated spike-like sails emerging from the top and underneath its neck. Females present a single decorative straight spike-like sail emerging from the top of its neck, and additional patterns on its caudal fin. They are carnivores. Dunklaestus is a loner who spends it's time in bodies of water that are easily accessible to land. It's hunting style relies on bursting out of the water, grabbing prey and dragging into the water to be eaten there. They nest their young on shore banks where both parents will take care of them, Dunklaestus split up after their young is born.
- They will move the frills along their body to communicate when underwater, similarly to sign language.
- Their frills also move around based on what they're doing; for example, when swimming they sag back to cut through the water better.
- When on land the frills help disperse heat and keep them cool.
- When laying, Dunklaestus will open their mouths to let small creatures clean their teeth.
- Dunklaestus sleep with half of their brain awake like dolphins can.
They love to sun bathe.

entries.name: Dyaelatura
entries.content:
The Dyaelatura is a creature with wing-like ornamental fins reminiscent of butterflies or paper kites. Its general body plan is that of a long, sloping theropod, but features two longer forelegs that make it quadrupedal. It has a theropod head with two fin-like protrusions sloping down from its jaw, as well as two antenna-like protuberances which extend over the body. Its shaggy neck is moderately long. On its back is a large, rounded hindwing, with the trailing edge elongated in the fashion of a Swallowtail butterfly. This also appears on its forelimbs, which also feature a paired forewing and a hindwing. Per foot, it has three digits for locomotion and a fourth, much more prominent claw turned upwards, presumably for attack. Though having a long tail, its true tail seems to terminate about halfway and the length is continued by an ornate extrusion, a plated pattern that ends in another swallowtail-like hindwing. Males have a slightly sharper chin. They are carnivores. A close relative to the Mekmek, Dyaelatura is a lightly built raptor-like creature with a carnivorous diet. They take on a terrestrial lifestyle and are swift with the ability to leap great distances. Dyaelatura is a solitary hunter and spends a majority of its time alone until it pairs with another to remain with as long as they live. They are very picky with partners and can take many years to find one.
- Dyaelatura are roughly as smart as ravens.
- Dyaelatura are drawn to bright colors and often will pick off colorful feathers, scales, frills, etc, off of larger creatures for fun. Paired Dyaelatura will often gift these to each other.
- Their attraction to color makes them particularly more susceptible to being lured by flashier predators.

entries.name: Eigion Warden
entries.content:
The Eigion Warden is a long, leviathan-like creature with 6 claw-tipped flippers along its torso, each one bearing one or more orange markings similar to eyes. It has multiple jagged spikes on its back and its tail bears fins shaped similarly to those of a shark which also have glowing spots. Its head is short with cheek fins and a throat that glows orange. It has 6 eyes arranged in diagonal lines that go towards the back of the creature and has a bulky torso. Like all Wardens, the Eigion Warden has a mask that floats near its head, though in the Eigion Warden's case it is oval shaped with a spiral marking in the middle and bears multiple growths on its sides. The Eigion Warden also has multiple parts that float near its fins. Males lack the orbs around the jaw the females have, but have 2 light bluish-gray spikes on their bottom jaw. Females have 2 small orange floating orbs near the bottom of their lower jaw. They are carnivores. Ruler of the depths and harbringer of darkness, this monster strikes fear into the hearts of even the strongest creatures. When you hear it's deep bellows, it's already too late.
- While Eigion Wardens can change the weather by will, their mood can also affect the climate. If the weather on the surface is particularly bad, it could be caused by an Eigion Warden upset over a failed hunt.
- Eigion Wardens can create whirlpools by swimming in circles rapidly, and the sheer power of these vortexes can wipe out some of the largest creatures. This is mostly used as a defense mechanism.
- The Eigion Warden has a very flexible hunting ground, though it prefers to pursue larger prey in the upper zones of the ocean.
- Its preferred way of hunting is stalking the prey from below or afar and catching it off guard with a sudden attack. It enjoys striking fear into the heart of anything it pursues.
- Both male and female members of the species will take care of their eggs, but will abandon them when they hatch.
- Their pups live in tropical environments, whereas adult Eigion Wardens are mostly found in colder climates.
- Eigion Wardens are usually solitary as adults, but juveniles form pods for protection, as most Eigion Wardens do not make it to adulthood. Those who form close social bonds might end up never leaving these pods.
- Eigion Wardens can hibernate in the deepest parts of the ocean for years without any food.
- The Eigion Warden's avatars show specific contempt towards avatars of the Angelic Warden and to Opralegions, and this goes both ways. The reason for this behavior currently seems to be lost to time.
- The "eyes" across the Eigion Warden's body are fake. These eye spots are meant to confuse any attacker.

entries.name: Eiroca
entries.content: The Eiroca appears to be a leviathan-like deep-sea creature, with many kelp-like fins sprouting from its body, and numerous bioluminescent markings. Its body consists of dark teal and light green hues. It has a thin, streamlined body bearing many striped markings. Males have two additional sets of whiskers. Females have two extra frills on their chest. They are carnivores. Eiroca swims in very deep waters, and uses its bioluminescent scales to safely navigate in the dark. This creature uses its excellent hearing to catch its prey, and travels at speed to hunt down anything that enters its territory.

entries.name: Elarickkeir
entries.content: The Elarickkeir presents a regal and imposing appearance, resembling a knight from fairy tales. It has sharp, retractable swords on both forearms, with ornaments embedded into it. The Elarickkeir is decorated with red crystals along its body, pairs of red and yellow ribbons on its back with diamond-shaped patterns, and a pair of thinner yellow ribbons extending from the base of its tail. The creature has two massive horns on the top of its head, with a floating crystal between them. It also has crystal "eyes" on its forehead, chest, and palms. The tip of its tail resembles that of a battle axe. Males sport large tusks near their lower jaw. Females sport ribbons in place of tusks. They are carnivores. Elarickkeir are noble heroic knights who serve and protect the royalty family from evil. With their tough armor, brute strength, and sharp sword blades, they are able to take down anybody who comes in their way.

entries.name: Emphines
entries.content: The Emphines is a slim, quadrupedal canine-like creature that is partially covered with fur on its ankles, back, neck, and thighs. It has long ears and a large spike on the end of its long, furless tail, which is also lined with smaller spikes. On its back are three large floating spikes, ordered from smallest to largest. Males have a single long, sharp horn on their forehead and an extra spike at the end of their tail. Females have three crystal-like growths on each of their cheeks. They are carnivores. A fast creature built for long distance running in the arctic environment. They chase their prey until it is exhausted. Usually dwells in cooler climates, avoids warm places.

entries.name: Empiterium
entries.content:
The Empiterium is a large, bipedal creature with a sword on its right "hand". It has golden, shield-like objects protecting its hands as well as a base of a golden color. It seemingly has a furred cape on its back with golden patterns and golden shards sprouting on its back and the top of its nose. It possesses a spike-like decoration that shoots forward from its nose, somewhat similar to a shark. Male Empiterium have two braids in their beard. They are carnivores. Empiterium is a strong creature with ancient power that walks Sonaria with is gallant sword and queen. It's known for its bravery and will protect creatures that return respect towards it.
- Empiterium usually stays by the side of his queen, Erridea. Empiterium and his queen are an inseparable pair of creatures.
- Empiterium doesn't have a specific habitat, he'll live wherever his queen goes.
- Empiterium swore to protect his queen with his sword even when in times of great sorrow and loss.
- Empiterium walks with pride and stride and has mutual respect amongst all the creatures.
- Empiterium likes to sit on large rocky ledges by lots of creatures to watch over them and to protect.
- Empiterium has an ancient rule saying that if the creatures respect him, he will respect them as well.
- Empiterium's crown on his head has never fallen.

entries.name: Equenix
entries.content: The Equenix is an armored quadrupedal creature that looks very similar to its relative, the Boskurro. It has a front-heavy build, featuring heavier forelegs than back legs. The entire length of the creature is covered in segmented armor plating, and a slime-like effect covers most of the body. The Equenix has a slim face with two large horns that curve to form a crescent shape when viewed from the front. A similar crescent shape can be found sprouting from the shoulders of this creature. On its tail, the armor plating stops, growing more like spikes that line the end of its tail. The remaining uncovered tail is also quite spiky, splitting off into 2 tail tips that form another crescent shape. Throughout the Equenix's body, glowing orbs can be found situated wherever there is a crescent shape (head, shoulders, tail tip). These orbs rotate when the creature is standing still. Females have a large spike on their rump. They are herbivores. Equenix are gentle and friendly giants that adopt orphaned and injured creatures. They have excellent swimming skills and are sometimes seen ferrying small creatures across rivers. On moonless nights Equenix glow with their patterns to communicate with other Equenix.

entries.name: Erridea
entries.content: The Erridea is a griffin-like creature with a royal aesthetic. Its head somewhat resembles an antelope's with a rounded beak and two pairs of ears. It has a crown and rubies embedded in its forehead. A white, horse-like mane stretches down to its shoulders, where its wings and the fluff of its cape meet. The cape/dress drags down, entirely covering its slender, white tail and a bit of its hind legs. The shape of its wings resemble that of a hummingbird or a gull, and its wing tips end in sharp red and gold decorations. It also has red and gold plating resembling jewelry located on the alula of its wings. The Erridea has a general color scheme of light beige, gold, white, red and purple. Females have extra strands of hair falling from the sides of their crown. They are herbivores. A majestic and self-satisfied creature, quite territorial and at every opportunity attacks any outsider encroaching on the territory. These creatures look down on everything, and always try to prove their superiority. They will never miss an opportunity to show off their jewelry.

entries.name: Eskarlor
entries.content: The Eskarlor is a medium-sized bipedal creature, with two long sword-like arms, each ending in three talons and a blade. Its back and tail are adorned with fur, as well as covered by what looks like scale armor. From its head protrudes a set of golden, pronged antlers and a heart-shaped fin. At the base of its tail are four long, thin protrusions that end in what seems to be a small scale. Males have four angular fins near the end of their tails. Females have two fins on both sides of their heads, as well as a tuft of fur below the base of their tails. They are carnivores. Eskarlor are regal pack carnivores who live in higher climates. These creatures hold themselves to a high standard by always keeping each other groomed and fit. When threatened an Eskarlor will rear up and flaunt its knives in a slashing motion.

entries.name: Etheralotus
entries.content: The Etheralotus is a large creature that resembles a wyvern. It has jagged wingtips and a spiky body. On its head and chin, it has a comb that looks like the ones on a chicken, particularly the Penedesenca breed. Its back, rump, and tail have connected tall spikes. The tail is thicker in the middle. There are patterns that look like eyes on the upper side of its wings and on the side of its tail. Some decorative elements hang from its lower jaw and rump. The bottom and tips of its wings have a web-like structure with two long claws. Males have forward-pointing horns. Females have backward-pointing horns. They are omnivores. These elusive omnivores seamlessly fly through the air, a freezing trail of sparkling dust following in pursuit.

entries.name: Eulopii
entries.content: Eulopiis are quadrupedal, frog-like creatures with a stout body, and a huge, flower bud-like tail. Their main body colors consist of various shades of green, with pink flowers and a pink underbelly. All over its back and by its elbows, the creature has flowers, including lily pads, and sprouts. Additionally, its back has a dark green puddle-like design where most of the flowers seem to grow, with patterns of pale green rings around it. The chest has a light pink, heart-shaped design with what looks like a single petal on each side. Eulopiis have a sprout extending from the top of their heads. They possess huge, round, non-bulging eyes, and has four toes on each foot. They also seem to lack a neck. Males have a flower bud on top the sprout on their heads and a single eyelash on both eyes. They are herbivores. Eulopii are tiny plant-like poison creatures, using toxicity as their primary defense. Eulopiis emit a scent similar to that of flowers, and have a naturally positive nature.

entries.name: Euvias
entries.content:
Euvias is slim and simple in appearance with four (4) wings, a long flat tail, short legs, and patches of fur on the neck, chin, head, and a larger clump on the chest. It wears five (5) well-spaced thin spines from the forehead to the middle of its neck and a short sail-like shape at the base of its tail. Several thick striped markings appear on the neck, shoulders, and end of the tail. It consists of light and dark blues, white, and dark gray. Males have one spur on both of their ankles. Females have a horn on their snouts. They are carnivores. Euvias are tiny wyvern-like creatures that reside in the frigid tundra and mountains. They hunt in packs, and use their icy breath to harass predators into leaving. They also like to pick on smaller animals and have a tendency to play with their food.
- The Euvias enjoys bullying smaller creatures, such as the Eulopii.

entries.name: Exotide
entries.content:
The Exotide is a tetrapodal-like creature with heavy fish-based elements, specifically from the flying fish in terms of ray-fish fin structures (with a homocercal, forked caudal fin; one well-developed pair of pectoral fins which work as wings; a smaller but developed pair of ventral fins; and two pairs of dorsal fins, with the first covering the "neck"), and the swordfish, in terms of a long, pointed bill. Additionally, it presents two pairs of axolotl-gill-like lobes stemming from the sides of the head, which seem to compliment the seven pairs of gills on its neck used for breathing; a second dorsal fin stemming from the same point as the ventral fins, being divided into three peduncules similar to the gill lobes mentioned previously; and a front pelvic fin partially mirroring the first dorsal fin. Unlike real-life swordfish, their bill is not flat, but slightly curved upwards, and seems to develop into some sort of helmet with additional, smaller and curved blades. They are carnivores. The Exotide species has evolved solely for the purpose of that to be in the environment of the air and sea, being quite the aggressive type whenever it comes to protecting their kin and territory and fighting furiously when they do.
- Despite their rough and mean look, the Exotide are quite social animals and enjoy the company of their own species, even showing self-sacrificing behaviors when it comes to their loved ones.
- Exotide have a similar intelligence level to real life dolphins and other high intelligence species, being able to experience fun and play with things like that of a dog playing with a chew toy or picking up specific things and dropping them onto creatures for fun.
- The Exotide species is mainly made up of females who are dominant in both hierarchy and hunting.

entries.name: Exterreri
entries.content:
The Exterreri is a large reptile-like creature similar to the Komodo dragon, but with some rauisuchian features, such as a Fasolasuchus. 'Fur' runs along its neck and ends in a long sickle-shaped tail. Additionally, it has boney fingers and toes. Several armor plates cover its tail and jaw. Each of its four legs are adorned with a large eye on the shoulder/thigh. The primary feature of the species is its elongated, rectangular head, which presents a large gap between its teeth and jaws, and its mouth displaying white sharp teeth, a red long pointed tongue; and three eyes on each side of its face, with horizontal slit pupils similar to that of a goat or sheep. Males have frills at the end of their tail. They are carnivores. Stalking humid climates, Exterreri are usually quite apathetic. They become very aggressive when their territory or mates are threatened.
- The Exterreri prefers to live in swamps.

entries.name: Fabráashé
entries.content:
The Fabráashé is a large, cat-like creature adorned with several egg-shaped ornaments, most noticeably on its back and tail. It has a ridge-like protrusion running along its back, forming a V-shape. Other notable decorations include the six 'frills', slightly resembling clockwork, it has on its face, three on each side, all ending in the same egg-shaped point. Its default palette consists of white as well as warm, pale gold shades. Males have a small, curled protrusion on their chin. They are carnivores. Fabráashé are brash creatures that hoard anything that glimmers like their porcelain-like coat. They adorn themselves with jewels and gold, taking pride in their collection.
- Fabráashé horde jewels to decorate their coats as they grow.
- Fabráashé find anything shiny or glimmering to adorn their coats with to impress others of their kind.

entries.name: Faecalu
entries.content: The Faecalu appears to draw a resemblance to orchid mantises with large, shield-like forelegs. It has flower petals adorning their necks and tails. Long, elegant feelers protrude from their cheeks and hind legs. They have round spikes at the bottom of their elbow and arm. Males have underbelly spikes. Females have two very long brow-like extensions on their faces. They are herbivores. Faecalu is a beautiful floral mantid creature with powerful and defensive claws with the ability to reflect attacks.

entries.name: Fairiocris
entries.content: The Fairiocris is a colorful quadrupedal creature, bearing several aspects of creatures such as butterflies or fairies. The creature has two large main wings on its back, along with several other wing-like protrusions located on its face, front arms, hind legs, and its neck. Its head is beaked, resembling that of a shoebill's, they also mildly look like a Western dragon. The Fairiocris' neck, lower back, and underside are adorned with spines; its back spines run down to its tail, which ends in a large flower-like shape. The Fairiocris' base color palette consists of many pastel shades of green, pink, purple, yellow, and white. Females have long antennae located on the top of their head. They are omnivores. As light as a feather, Fairiocris dance around the skies full of joy. Fairiocris love gathering in groups and caring for one another. Sometimes other creatures mistake them for butterflies.

entries.name: Feliafaux
entries.content: The Felifaux's base form is similar to that of a black house cat, with fur similar to that of a british shorthair, except it’s black. And similar body proportions to that of a munchkin cat. It has darkened fur and beady eyes with large black pupils. It’s head is large and on it are small whiskers and pointed ears along with a small fake mouth. It has a mane of grey fur that leads from its neck to the underbelly and ends where the tail lies. Its body is short and plump with 4 small legs that have blue paw prints. The Felifaux's mutated form has extra bony growths that appear at the back of the head and the base of the tail. It has dilated pupils, and its true mouth has sharp teeth with a glowing blue interior. The tail splits into 5 long and bony arms held in close proximity to each other with the use of a black goo-like substance. Each skeletal hand has 5 fingers and is also webbed in the same black substance. The same blue glow from its mouth also emanates from an open part of the Felifaux's tail base. They are carnivores. The Felifaux is Sonaria's cutest, fuzziest critter! They love big treats and are the ... perfect... creature to cuddle with!

entries.name: Felikxtrox
entries.content: The Felikxtrox is a ceratopsid dinosaur resembling some of the most evolved species among the clade, such as Triceratops and Torosaurus, but with an additional set of feather-like plated scales covering their entire body, in a similar disposition to some pangolins, and branch-like horns. Additional spikes not unlike those covering their spider-like frills protect their back and tail, while bigger, sharper spikes protect the sides of their tail base and tip. Males have a large spike on the tip of their tail along with a smaller spike on the bridge of their nose, before their nose spike. They are herbivores. Felikxtrox sharp thorns and crazy bright pattern make them seem aggressive and dangerous, when in reality they are the nicest creature there is. They are lovable and playable and love to roll in muds all day. They are also very overprotective towards babies and small critters who are lost or hurt.

entries.name: Fellisio
entries.content:
Fellisio is a quadrupedal hexapod with a dragon-like appearance, resembling some feline or mollusc characteristics. It has a soft, smooth skin without fur or feathers, with two wings extending from its back. Its thick limbs are supported by four-fingered, larger paws, and its walking legs end in a five-fingered paw. Each ankle is adorned with frills, and additional frills decorate the tail base, the tip of the tail, and the chest. The head has four eyes, each containing two pairs of smaller cerata that protrude from behind them. The top of the head has two modified cerata, which look like long ears with frill extensions, and the top of the neck has eight cerata, three of which have a bioluminescence tip. Along the body, Fellisio is covered in a variety of colors, including blues, grays, purples, pinks, and yellows. Males have an extra bioluminescent-tipped cerata above their forehead, pointing backwards. They are carnivores. A mysterious flier of the dark caverns and night skies, and an alluring swimmer of the deep dark blue. Fellisio is a fearsome predator of the land, sky, and seas...but wait, is it playing with a ball of moss??? It's purring too?!
- Fellisios act like real-life cats; purring, hissing, and even puffing up frills are all part of their unique behavior.
- Juvenile Fellisio are very close to each other, always sticking to each other and play-fighting until they are big enough to hunt for themselves.
- The males of this species are quite territorial, puffing up their hoods to large sizes to assert dominance.
- They originally evolved to have a glow to help attract prey in the dark, but now that the most recent generations have developed great night-vision, they use it to attract others of their species.
- Fellisio have developed a secondary pair of eyes as well as ‘pit’ nostrils for extremely efficient night-hunting. They're very much nocturnal, and also can hunt in murky waters.

entries.name: Fernifly
entries.content: The Fernifly is a flat-broad-headed, small, lizard-like reptile similar to Longisquama in terms of its back ridges. It features a spot pattern on its spines and broad, forked tail which resembles a samara. Its tail is massive compared to its body, making up about half of Fernifly's full length. It also has a dewlap on its throat. Males have a large rounded head crest that has spots on it. Females possess no crest atop their head. They are photovores, which means they only need water and sunlight to survive. The Fernifly is a funky little plant lizard with an unsatiated appetite for extreme violence and world domination. Using its incredible helicopter ability to fly through the skies at incredible speeds, the Fernifly is definitely not an opponent to be messed with.

entries.name: Ferrah
entries.content: The Ferrah resembles an ungulate, with slender legs and three hooved toes on each foot. Its body appears somewhat short and barrel-shaped in contrast with its long tail, neck, and face, from which sprout tall, quill-like growths. It has gill-like vents on both of its sides, the top of which is lined with a row of feathery structures. Ferrah has long, tufted ears and narrow eyes. Its mouth is considerably wide and opens to reveal sharp teeth. Ferrah is predominantly violet with prominent white, red, and yellow markings. Males have long dewclaws on each of their front feet. Females have longer feathering above the gills on their sides. They are carnivores. Ferrah are sleek and thin creatures built for speed and endurance. Their large chest cavities hold an incredibly strong diaphragm and pair of lungs, enabling them to sprint long distances without tiring. Although fragile, they hunt best among packs to take down their prey in long distance chases... that is, if their prey even has the chance to escape.

entries.name: Firakai
entries.content: Firakai is a front-heavy quadruped resembling the exhaust plume of a rocket. The whole creature is covered in fiery spikes, some of which float.
